accepted_scoped_findings: Mean-label candidate loss is a distinct readout from greedy decoding; report mean/raw/first-label and actual greedy predictions separately.
Balanced class pairs do not prohibit image-independent answer-bias correction; fixed null and within-person opposite-truth image contrasts remain necessary.
Image intensity/contrast discrimination does not demonstrate brain-anatomical reasoning.
Two updates/eight train images cannot establish method novelty, robust generalization or successful Vero transfer.

preserved_disagreements.arbitrary_KILL_thresholds: Half-null-shift and one-pair score-disagreement thresholds are unvalidated proposals, not adopted scientific gates. Prior and visual interaction effects will be reported separately.

blank_shift_ratio_is_not_valid_KILL.meaning: An equal null/mean-real prior shift can coexist with better paired visual discrimination; ratio .5 is not a valid universal falsifier.

unchanged_greedy_does_not_falsify_contin.meaning: Visual-score evidence can change without accuracy gain; report no accuracy improvement, not absence of any visual effect.

preserved_disagreements.scope_extrapolation: Claude read only objective and tests, not the separate frozen full40 patient-disjoint dev evaluation entry. Its statement that no held-out evaluation exists is not established for the planned experiment.
preserved_disagreements.swapped_label_training: An inverted-label model can learn an inverted visual mapping. Reduced mislabeled training loss alone cannot identify a prior-only mechanism; never use swapped-image wrong truth as ordinary evaluation.
